content.short: GetBlock is a premier node provider offering instant access to TON nodes via JSON-RPC, REST, and WebSockets.
content.description: GetBlock is a comprehensive blockchain node provider that offers seamless API access to the TON network. It supports various connection methods including JSON-RPC, REST, and WebSockets, providing developers with the flexibility they need to build sophisticated dApps, wallets, and bots. GetBlock's robust infrastructure ensures 99% uptime and high performance, making it a reliable choice for TON projects of all sizes. By providing easy access to real-time network data, GetBlock accelerates the development and deployment of new services on TON.
